lines.en: It whirls, the Macedonian dance whirls,

lines.cyr: голем собор ми се собрал крај Вардарот.
lines.lat: golem sobor mi se sobral kraj Vardarot.
lines.en: a great gathering has assembled by the Vardar.

lines.cyr: Оро и песна, сонце и љубов,
lines.lat: Oro i pesna, sonce i ljubov,
lines.en: Dance and song, sun and love,
All the Macedonian people have gathered,
embraced like brothers to make merry.

lines.cyr: Оро и песна, сонце и љубов,
lines.lat: Oro i pesna, sonce i ljubov,
lines.en: Dance and song, sun and love,

lines.cyr: Дали гледаш, мило Скопје, дали слушаш
lines.lat: Dali gledaš, milo Skopje, dali slušaš
lines.en: Do you see, dear Skopje, do you hear
how a Macedonian song is sung?

lines.cyr: Оро и песна, сонце и љубов,
lines.lat: Oro i pesna, sonce i ljubov,
lines.en: Dance and song, sun and love,
